description: Signatures in CexChain wire encoding (ECDSA and SM2 as r||s; ESP256 in low-S form). Each valid vector is followed by variants with a modified message and a modified signature. ESP256 and SM2 vectors are also checked by pure-Python verifiers. Invalid vectors may carry expected_error (default verification_failed).
